name: FUN_PARALLEL_SETUP
description: This table contains the default metadata for parallel runs, and run-specific metadata for parallel runs where the default metadata is overridden.

columns.name: PARALLEL_SETUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of  the parallel setup.

columns.name: PARALLEL_JOB_CODE
columns.description: Parallel job for which this parallel run was submitted.

columns.name: ORACLE_SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the parallel setup was seeded by Oracle or not.

columns.name: PARALLEL_RUN_ID
columns.description: Parallel run that created this row in cases where the data dynamically created as versus Oracle seeded. Contains the value 1 for all seeded rows.

columns.name: MANUAL_JOB_SUBMISSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether all jobs for this parallel run will be submitted manually.

columns.name: PROCESS_PHASES_SERIALLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates in the case of multi-phase jobs, whether the phases should be processed sequentially or whether they can overlap.

columns.name: MINIMUM_ESS_THREADS
columns.description: Minimum Enterprise Service Scheduler threads this parallel setup requires to run (excluding PL/SQL slots).

columns.name: MINIMUM_PLSQL_SLOTS
columns.description: Minimum PL/SQL slots this parallel setup requires to run.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAUNCH_JOBS_AT_INIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether any additional threads will be launched when the initialization API is called. When the value is N, system waits for subsequent calls to the parallelism APIs to launch additional threads.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
